Maya (Docs): FYI I opened a compact PR to tighten up the errref section on 429s, timeouts, and stream recovery. Goal: one short troubleshooting card, two tiny snippets (JS + curl), and a migration note covering Retry-After-ms vs Retry-After sec. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3542

Raj (SDK): good. i'll supply the header-normalization snippet and a small unit-test. here's the normalize helper i'm going to include: 

```js
function parseRetryAfter(hdr) {
  if (!hdr) return 1000; // default 1s
  const n = parseInt(hdr, 10);
  if (isNaN(n)) return 1000;
  return n > 1000 ? n : n * 1000; // heuristic: >1000 is ms
}
```

Raj (SDK): i'll also mention we check for >1000 to disambiguate legacy second values from ms values.

Zoe (EngRuntime): runtime note: two distinct codes you'll see: `stream_interrupted` (metadata: partial_tokens) and `rate_limited` (metadata: retry_hint). Sometimes both are present for the same attempt. Recommend docs say: prefer variant fallback over aggressive client retries when both are seen.

Maya (Docs): drafting a tiny checklist: 1) Is the 429 spike bursty or sustained? 2) Inspect retry_hint / Retry-After header 3) If partial_tokens present, choose resume (if KV persisted) vs non-streaming retry 4) For context_length_exceeded, trim client prompt before retrying 5) If concurrent 429+stream_interrupted, route to lower-capacity variant instead of retry storms.

Lina (PM): please add a one-line migration blurb: "We now allow millisecond Retry-After values in some infra paths. Clients should tolerate both formats during migration." Mark as release-note worthy.

Raj (SDK): will add a one-line test cover for parseRetryAfter with values 5 (sec), 5000 (ms), and undefined.

Maya (Docs): snippets: short JS resume example and a curl example showing read of the header. will keep everything compact to fit the errref style.

Maya (Docs): proposed wording for stream recovery paragraph: "If the runtime returns stream_interrupted, you may receive partial_tokens. For strict correctness, retry in non-streaming mode after trimming prompt density. For best-effort UX, resume by replaying or appending a recovery prompt using persisted KV. Avoid aggressive retries if rate_limited is also signaled; instead route to a lower-capacity model variant."

Zoe (EngRuntime): feel free to quote: "When partial output is returned, treat it as a best-effort fragment. Prefer graceful fallbacks (variant routing or trimmed retries) over retry storms that can exacerbate throttling."
